logic.entry: Aggregate UTC daily high/low,last close and base volume over1440closed minutes. CLV=(2*C-H-L)/(H-L);if H=L,set CLV0,retain volume in denominator. CMF=sum(CLV*base_volume)/sum(base_volume) overNcomplete days j-N+1..j;if total volume0,set CMF0. Exact Fraction from encoded daily Float64 decimal strings;no rounding for thresholds,Decimal60 display,canonical ratio SHA for decisions. Original accounting kernel remainsDecimal28. No price-gap adjustment,seed or fold reset. When flat,enter iff CMF>entry_cmf_threshold_fraction;exact rational strict comparison,no prior-cross requirement.
logic.exit: While long,exit iff CMF<-0.05. Equality-0.05and zero-volume0keep long;flat stays cash at or below entry threshold. No future padding,fold reset,short,hold cap or same-decision re-entry. Costed terminal liquidation.
logic.sizing: Independent 2,000 USDT cash account; all original capital allocated to this asset; long-only, no leverage, no borrowing, no cross-asset transfer or add-on.
logic.timing: Close-based signal only from a closed UTC daily bar, next day 00:01 UTC one-minute open (60-second delay); no historical fill before OOS.

parameters.impact_model: 0.5 * sample_stdev(previous 20 complete UTC daily log returns) * sqrt(order quote budget / previous 20 complete daily quote-volume ADV)
parameters.flow_arithmetic: exact Fraction from daily Float64 decimal-string encoding
parameters.threshold_arithmetic: exact rational comparisons;decision CSV canonical ratio SHA
